answer: Mechanism: split-context quill attestation. Admission issues two independent challenges in namespaces ledge and zephyr; each agent returns a fresh context-local nonce and signature for both, plus a Merkle commitment binding them. A clone sharing one seed/state cannot emit distinct nonces without diverging; identical nonces collide and are rejected. To field N sybils, an attacker must instantiate N independently seeded signing states, paying N× key generation, storage, and rotation, rather than copying one agent. Honest agents fork state cheaply per context.
